baseline: Standalone Omarchy plugin commit 36a56b14f9497170b0de49cb3ca9618b6e1864c6; Service.qml pipes curl output to StdioCollector. No dependency additions.

coverage.reason: The fix changes the Dispatch fetch producer only; no controls or layout change.
Dispatch responses remain transient and no stored state or schema changes.
The configured remote Dispatch endpoint is untrusted and its response must be bounded before collection.
The existing HTTP status/content-type trailer, pagination, timeout and legacy fallback must remain compatible.
Quickshell launches the bounded helper and must not leave its curl child alive when the request is cancelled.
Existing status and error presentation stays in place; no controls or accessibility semantics change.
The actual production fetch helper must reject oversized length-delimited and chunked responses before forwarding bytes.
Use bounded streaming reads and preserve the repository's existing helper-process boundary.

behavior.behavior: Limit streamed input while it is being read instead of buffering an unbounded response and truncating afterward.
behavior.do_not_copy: Do not copy Werkzeug's code or add its dependency; use only the bounded-reader principle in the existing Python/curl stack.

platform.requirement: Read child stdout with a fixed maximum, route child stderr away from an unbounded collector, terminate and reap the child on overflow or cancellation, and preserve the existing curl wall-clock deadline.

proof: python3 tests/dispatch-fetch.e2e.py runs the production fetch helper against local normal, exact-limit, oversized, chunked, legacy-status, and stalled-response fixtures and writes a JSON result artifact.
tests/run executes the portable regression suite including the new bounded-fetch end-to-end check.
The exported 1.3.2 release candidate passes native `omarchy plugin validate` and the Omarchy plugin structure validator.

selection: Add a small stdlib Python fetch wrapper that invokes the existing curl argv, retains --max-time 5, caps raw stdout and response body before output, caps/discards child stderr, and emits no partial response on any failure. Keep Service.qml's existing HTTP parsing and fallback behavior.
